deploy-bot: rollback initiated: environment=prod-usw2, release_tag=release-v2.7.4, target_revert=release-v2.7.3, by=deploy-bot, reason=error-rate spike on /v1/generate and kv-cache mismatch detected. trace_id=rbk-2143658700. Rolling back traffic now.
ana: ack. joining. what is the ETA for traffic switch?
kevin: how long until both canaries and global are flipped? any DB migrations involved?
jess: no DB migrations in v2.7.4 — just runtime kernel bump + model variant. should be safe to revert.
ana: nice, thanks. please pin v2.7.3 after rollback so autoscaler doesn't accidentally promote v2.7.4 during bursts.
mike-sre: on it. pinning request to releases service: pin release-v2.7.3 -> reason: emergency rollback; owner=eng-releases. cmd: `releases pin release-v2.7.3 --until 2026-04-04`
ops-bot: releases service: pin accepted. ticket=REL-4829. expires=2026-04-04T07:00:00Z.
deploy-bot: rollback progress: canary 1/3 reverted, canary 2/3 queued, global drain in progress. estimated completion ~3m.
kevin: monitoring: watch 5xx rate, p99 latency, and kv miss rate. hit the metrics dashboard: https://monitoring.internal/redwood/prod-usw2?panel=deploy-rollback
jess: adding a quick smoke check: POST /health -> 200 expected, run on two zones.
mike-sre: rollback completed: environment=prod-usw2, reverted_to=release-v2.7.3, completed_by=mike-sre (manual resume), duration=5m25s, deploy_job=deploy/rollback/2143658700. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: deploybot: revert deploy finished. record updated: REL-4829 -> status=rolled_back.
nana: confirmed pin active and traffic stable. 5xx back to baseline. kv cache miss normalized. :thumbsup:
kevin: quick follow-ups: 1) schedule a postmortem if rollout root cause unknown; 2) tag release-v2.7.4 as blocked until root cause fixed; 3) confirm rollback doesn't require DB migration reversal (we heard none).
jess: opening a short incident doc and linking PRs. created: https://wiki.redwood/incident/2143658700-rollback. will add timeline and perf graphs.
mike-sre: can someone capture the failing logs? I pulled a sample: ```json
{"ts":2143658689,"service":"runtime","err":"kv cache version mismatch","commit":"a1b2c3d4"}
```
nana: good catch. tagging the release: release-v2.7.4 -> status=investigating.
kevin: assign to eng-runtime + eng-ml for root cause. pinging @jess @samir for postmortem items.
jess: noted. will add action items: rollback checklist, revert-action test, canary safeguards.
ops-bot: reminder: change window note added to REL-4829: emergency rollback outside regular window.
nana: thumbs up. once RCA done we'll coordinate a safe re-roll with a small canary and a KV compatibility check.
mike-sre: final: leaving the channel open for 15m for any regression spikes. otherwise closing in 15. :lock:
nana: thanks everyone. great coordination.
kevin: thanks — nice and clean revert. filing follow-up ticket to automate pin-on-rollback.
ops-bot: thread archived by ops-bot after 15m of inactivity.
